page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard4.Ax.Flex.39-312 is a general-purpose virtual server configured with dedicated x86_64 hardware resources. The instance runs on Intel Xeon 6987C-P processors clocked at 3.9 GHz. It provisions 78 vCPUs across 39 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading active at two threads per core. Memory capacity totals 312.0 GB RAM, providing a balanced resource distribution of 4.0 GB of memory per core.

The hardware configuration does not bundle local disk storage or hardware accelerators, leaving the local storage size at none and GPU count at zero. Persistent data storage must be attached via remote block volumes. One complimentary public IPv4 address is assigned for direct external networking. Because physical CPU allocation is dedicated, the instance avoids shared-core resource contention, presenting a predictable execution environment suited for enterprise compute demands.

By maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio across a high core count, this server provides efficient resource density without the premium cost overhead associated with GPU accelerators or local NVMe arrays. Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard4.Ax.Flex.39-312 is suitable for enterprise application hosting, batch data processing, continuous integration and deployment pipelines, container orchestration nodes, and distributed web serving.
